name: Brigandine
description: Small iron plates riveted between layers of cloth. Looks like a coat until someone swings at it.
notes: Medium body armor, between leather and mail; weight within the mail reference range. Weight 6.5 kg (ADR-0003 reference weights). Catalogue tier common (economy doc, body armor medium 180-300). Authored for shop stock (mw-ju8.3); not for sale until a shop row stocks it (mw-ju8.5).
